topic: 1990 magnetic phase transition — q558 verification of Chulliat citation + threshold-mechanism anchor patch (ISS-2901)
our_argument_summary: WIN-022 remains Misleading. Duplicate of WIN-007 (same NOAA NP.xy data, same PROS-002 parent prediction); ‘phase transition’ is a structural category error — no order parameter, no symmetry breaking, no critical exponents. Patch added the Chulliat & Newitt (2010, EOS 91:49) citation alongside Livermore et al. (2020) in detail_evidence so the post-hoc claim is now auditable against two independent pre-dome sources, and tightened the category-error sentence to anchor on the dome’s explicit threshold-mechanism wording with a verbatim PROS-002 quote (raw-text/02-wins.txt:21).

kernel_of_truth.description: The dome correctly notices a real and abrupt event — the 1990s NMP acceleration is not merely a continuation of slow centuries-long drift but a relatively sudden ~4× rate jump concentrated in ~13 years (data/wins.json:WIN-022 detail_evidence cites Chulliat & Newitt 2010 + Livermore et al. 2020).
kernel_of_truth.why_it_doesnt_save_claim: The abruptness was already documented in pre-dome literature (Chulliat & Newitt 2010, EOS 91:49; Livermore et al. 2020, Nat. Geosci. 13:387–391) and is fully explained by Canadian-flux-lobe elongation on the core-mantle boundary. Relabeling as ‘phase transition’ adds no order parameter, no symmetry breaking, no critical exponents, and no derivation from dome geometry — and the dome counts the same NP.xy observation twice (WIN-007 + WIN-022) under different labels per its own PROS-002 organizational structure (raw-text/02-wins.txt:22).
